name: LogiQA 2.0
description: An improved version of LogiQA benchmark for testing logical reasoning on natural language passages. Includes more challenging reasoning patterns and better-quality questions with clearer logical structures.
reputation: Improved benchmark for evaluating logical reasoning from natural text; more challenging than original LogiQA
notes: Addresses quality issues in original LogiQA. Better designed logical reasoning questions that resist pattern matching and require genuine comprehension.
